description: Defines fictional candidate profiles and their intended testing scenarios for the ZecPath AI-powered hiring system.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test how the system processes a strong candidate with relevant skills and experience.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: Candidate should demonstrate strong alignment with the MERN job description and complete all assessment stages.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test a candidate with reasonable job-related skills but average technical and communication performance.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should evaluate the candidate based on actual skill matching and assessment responses.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test ATS matching and interview evaluation for a candidate with limited mandatory skills.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should identify missing skills and reflect the candidate's actual assessment performance.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test how the system handles a fresher applying for a Java Developer position requiring 3 to 6 years of experience.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should identify the experience gap and evaluate the candidate according to the configured eligibility rules.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test an experienced candidate with strong Java and enterprise development knowledge.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should recognize relevant experience and technical knowledge and process the candidate through all assessment stages.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test a Python candidate with additional AI, machine learning and NLP specialization.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should identify relevant Python skills and evaluate the candidate's additional technical specialization.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test mandatory skill validation and candidate eligibility decisions.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should detect the missing MongoDB skill and apply the configured mandatory-skill eligibility rules.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test ATS performance for a candidate with limited relevant skills and a weak resume.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should identify skill gaps and evaluate the candidate using the actual assessment results.

candidates.testing_purpose: Test how the system evaluates communication skills alongside technical knowledge.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should evaluate HR performance separately from technical performance.

expected_weaknesses: Experience below the job's minimum requirement
candidates.testing_purpose: Test incomplete assessment handling and missing-stage detection.
candidates.expected_pipeline_behavior: System should preserve the candidate's incomplete status and must not generate fabricated assessment scores.
